title: Editor E6 slice: the canvas fits a phone, and a block can be duplicated, hidden, removed and put back with Undo
detail:
Split from PROG-E6 on 2026-11-16, after PROG-E6B. PROG-E6B's own known limits: a block could not be removed on the canvas, there was no undo, and on a phone the desktop frame (1280px) scrolled sideways. PROG-E6's own bar: the full authoring path must finish on a phone. Dark; the EDITOR_CANVAS default is unchanged.

Premise re-tested (ADR-1082): the node document already holds everything needed. A node has its own `hidden` flag (node-tree.ts), and the stored bench keeps a lifted block with its words (benchNode). So no document shape change, no migration and no SQL.

What now works. (1) Duplicate: a copy with every bag the block holds (words, tablet and phone changes, style, hidden) lands right under it and is selected; the copy is made on the server from what is stored, so the tab sends no content. (2) Hide and Show: one block is hidden in place; the layer tree marks it Hidden and keeps its slot. (3) Remove: the block moves to the page's bench, words intact, so it stays in the Space page builder's tray; the neighbour is selected. The last block on a page cannot be removed (the canvas reads a page with none as no page), and a full bench (48) refuses rather than trimming. (4) Undo: every change to the page's shape (move, spacing, hide, remove, put back, add) queues its opposite as it is sent (lib/builder/canvas-tree.ts undoChange); an add queues its own final removal once the server names the new block. An undo is one more change through the same write and the same base; a refused change takes its undo with it; a run of spacing steps on one edge undoes in one step; up to 30 steps. Typing is not on the stack: a field keeps the browser's own text undo. (5) The phone: the frame is drawn smaller to fit the room it has (canvasFitScale, never below a quarter; pointer mapping already handled a scaled frame), and on a screen under 640px the canvas opens on the Phone frame so the handles in it keep their size.

One write path: all of it rides saveCanvasNodeDraft (app/(main)/pages/canvas/document-actions.ts), the action PROG-E5B shipped and PROG-E6B extended, through planCanvasDraftWrite and applyCanvasChange and the same guarded update. A put-back counts against the block's per-page limit again, so a page that has since filled it says no.

VERIFIED: unit tests for the undo math and the fit scale; the action end to end with the data layer mocked (duplicate with every bag, hide and show, remove to the bench and put back, final removal, the last block, a filled limit, the switch, staff and read-only doors, and content sent with a copy dropped); the client queue under jsdom (duplicate, hide, remove, then three undos in reverse, each on the base the last returned; a move and a spacing run undone; a refused change drops its undo). Driven in Chromium: the shipped canvas components bundled with the real action and model, only auth, flags and the database stubbed (a throwaway harness, not committed), at 390px: Duplicate, Hide, Remove, then Undo three times, the stored draft checked after each step. Pictures at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 px, light and dark, before and after, in /mnt/project-files/editor/e6c/. NOT VERIFIED: the live route with a signed-in staff account and a database (this box has neither); no finger on a real phone.

Known limits, stated plainly: rows and columns themselves still cannot be added, removed or reordered here; the frame still draws only the selected block, not the page; field typing is not on the undo stack; there is no redo; a hidden or removed block is still listed by its type name, not its words.

verify.note: Runs the shipped draft action and canvas read with only framework, auth and database replaced. Fails on main: no block actions, no duplicate, hide, remove or put-back change on the draft action, no fit scale. Passes when a copy lands under its block with every bag, hide and show flip one block and the tree says so, a removal keeps its words on the bench and a put-back returns it to its slot, undoing an add leaves no trace, the last block stays, a stale tab is refused, nothing writes with the switch off, for non-staff or read-only, and the canvas mounts the actions, opens on the Phone frame on a phone and fits its frame.
